$comment: Account-level MCP connectors as the session tool inventory actually names them.
Measured 2026-09-01: the connectors that .claude/settings.json and the tool
authority matrix call mcp__claude_ai_Supabase__*, mcp__claude_ai_Vercel__* and
mcp__claude_ai_Sentry__* appear in the live session under a UUID prefix
(mcp__<uuid>__<tool>) and NOT under any mcp__claude_ai_* name. A deny rule
keyed on the display-name spelling therefore matches nothing the session can
call. The UUID spellings are denied too, and this file is the ONE place the
ids live so the tool-authority fingerprint, the enforcement inventory and the
verifier all read the same value.
UUID STABILITY ACROSS SESSIONS IS UNVERIFIED. One session cannot prove it.
If a connector is re-installed or re-authorised its id may rotate, at which
point every mcp__<uuid>__ deny rule silently matches nothing again. That is
config/control-plane-gaps.json, and `npm run control-plane:verify` reports the
ids here against the deny rules on every run (tools/mcp-deny-connector-ids).
To re-measure: in an interactive session, list the tool inventory and copy the
prefix of the connector's tools here. Update observed_at when you do.
